shortDescription: Manage AFM DoS profiles on a BIG-IP

options.name: default_whitelist
options.description: The default whitelist address list for the system to use to determine which IP addresses are legitimate. The system does not examine traffic from the IP addresses in the list when performing DoS prevention. To define a new whitelist, use the C(bigip_firewall_address_list) module.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of the DoS profile.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the profile.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource is removed.

options.name: threshold_sensitivity
options.description: Specifies the threshold sensitivity for the DoS profile. Thresholds for detecting attacks are higher when sensitivity is C(low), and lower when sensitivity is C(high). When creating a new profile, if this parameter is not specified, the default is C(medium).
